stepBody: Claire wants to impute the missing entries of $$hour_{of,visit}$$ with the mode of its same activity category. For example, if any row with activity "grade" has a missing value for $$hour_{of,visit}$$, the missing values should be replaced by the mode of $$hour_{of,visit}$$ for "grade" activities. Fill in the blanks to accomplish this.##figure1.gif## ##figure2.gif##
